feeds.title: Penny Pinchin Mom Blog
feeds.description: Hii! I'm Tracie! I am a mom of 3 amazing kids! I share tips to help people get out of debt, save money, budget, make amazing recipes, parenting tips, and more!

feeds.title: Saving Dollars & Sense Blog
feeds.description: Covers posts on saving money, frugal tips, healthy living and shopping deals. Kristie Sawicki is a homeschool mom who is Helping you change the way you save by bringing you all the best deals, coupons, freebies, and ideas she can find.

feeds.title: Money Saving Mom » Non Deal
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Crystal Paine, the blessed wife of Jesse and mom of four precious children. MoneySavingMom is my financial advice blog for moms since 2007 informing and helping on various topics such as Online Deals, Managing Money, Earning Income, and more.

feeds.title: A Dime Saved
feeds.description: My name is Robyn, and I am a millennial mom on a tight budget! A Dime Saved is a Personal finance site for financial newbies and those desperate enough to save a dime.

feeds.title: Coupons And Freebies Mom
feeds.description: Articles on deals, earning, saving and personal finance. Jaime is a married mom of 2 young & energetic boys. Soon after leaving her job, she realized her true passion was to be at home with her kiddos & helping others save money. Now she shares the hottest freebies, coupons & deals here at Coupons & Freebies Mom.

feeds.title: Wealthy Single Mommy » Money
feeds.description: Build an amazing single mom life with money, career, parenting and dating, by award-winning journalist, activist and author, Emma Johnson. Get the advice about how to set big goals, build amazing careers, save and get out of debt and earn more money.

feeds.title: Smart Money Mamas Blog
feeds.description: Smart Money Mamas is on a mission to get moms talking about money. And not just the pretty wins, but the mistakes and struggles and stumbles. Uncovering the money mantras that are lifting us up and the ones that are holding us back. So that we can understand we are and start making positive moves forward.

feeds.title: Moneywise Moms » Saving Money
feeds.description: I'm Gina, a mom of three in Northern Virginia. I blog about family finance and frugality to help stressed moms manage their family budgets.

feeds.title: Single Moms Income
feeds.description: I'm Alexa and I started this blog in 2012 as a way of chronicling my journey as a single mother trying to beat the vicious cycle of dead end jobs and paycheck to paycheck living. My blog provides creative ways to earn and save money.

feeds.title: Centsable Momma » Save Money
feeds.description: Corrie is a frugal wife and mom of 2 boys who loves to share money-saving tips on the blog, 'Cents'able Momma as well as the best deals and coupons.

feeds.title: Deal Seeking Mom
feeds.description: Articles on personal finance, savings, great deals and coupons. DealSeekingMom is the destination for money-savvy modern moms that want the most for their hard-earned cash. According to the author, squeezing champagne out of a tap water budget is totally achievable for those in the know.

feeds.title: Handful of Thoughts
feeds.description: Handful of Thoughts is a resource dedicated to helping moms take control of their time and money. It is the intersection of money, mindset, and mom life.

feeds.title: Happy Humble Home » Money

I blog about living a frugal life without being miserable, destroying my debt, being a new mom and sticking to a budget.

feeds.title: Mama Loves Money

feeds.title: Life and a Budget » Money
feeds.description: Life and a Budget is created to help women and their families create better finances while enjoying a little carefree living! I'm a Certified Financial Education Instructor (CFEI), freelance writer, goal chasing, mama to two kids.
